note: Scanner revisions the workbench recognises. Prefixes are Git commit prefixes of AmScope-Camera. Edit this file, not scan_bridge.py, when a scanner release changes.

revisions.zh: 954-1080p-A1：已加入实际1920 × 1080图像检查及Claude字体层。新版本仅完成离线检查，等待两轮3 × 3实机与拼接验收；旧954点结果不能当作本版验证。
revisions.en: 954-1080p-A1 adds received 1920 × 1080 image checks and Claude typography. Offline checks completed; two new 3 × 3 instrument/stitching trials are pending. The original 954-point result does not validate this release.

revisions.zh: 历史字体版本8a7cd29，已由954-1080p-A1替代。该次显示更新的Windows实机界面验证仍待完成，也没有新的954点实机验证。
revisions.en: Historical typography revision 8a7cd29, superseded by 954-1080p-A1. Windows instrument UI validation of that display update remains pending; it has no new 954-point instrument validation.

revisions.zh: 历史L1基线，已由954-1080p-A1替代。954点记录属于学生原始采集程序；新增语言界面未经过该次长扫验证。
revisions.en: Historical L1 baseline, superseded by 954-1080p-A1. The 954-point record belongs to the student acquisition source, not the added language UI.

unknown.zh: 当前检出尚未归入已核对发布版本；请核对实际源码和交付清单。实机验证范围应以对应版本说明为准。
unknown.en: This checkout is not a recognized reviewed release; check the actual source and delivery manifest. Instrument-validation scope must be checked for the corresponding release.

no_revision.en: Scanner version cannot be confirmed: neither a Git record nor delivery_manifest.json is present. Use the complete student package issued by the project lead.
